description.zh: 一条内容带在水平方向匀速循环滚动，首尾无缝衔接。 用于 logo 墙、合作方名单、公告与促销横幅——用"连续流动"表达数量多与不间断， 而不是引导用户逐条读完。
description.en: A horizontal strip of content scrolling continuously and looping seamlessly. Used for logo walls, partner lists, announcements and promo banners — the endless flow signals abundance; it never asks users to read every item.

use_when.zh: 合作方/logo 墙，展示"很多谁在用我们"
use_when.en: Logo walls showing who else trusts the product

use_when.zh: 公告条、促销横幅的循环展示
use_when.en: Announcement bars and looping promo banners

use_when.zh: 内容远超容器宽度且无需逐条阅读
use_when.en: Content far wider than the container that nobody must read in full

avoid_when.zh: 用户必须读完的关键信息（读不完就焦虑）
avoid_when.en: Critical copy users must finish reading

avoid_when.zh: 需要停顿细看、可交互的条目
avoid_when.en: Items users need to pause on and click

avoid_when.zh: 移动端窄屏塞长条带（速度感知更快更晕）
avoid_when.en: Long strips on narrow mobile screens — perceived speed worsens

note.zh: 内容复制两份位移 -50% 循环，首尾无接缝
note.en: Duplicate the content, translate -50% — no visible seam

note.zh: hover 时 animation-play-state: paused 方便查看
note.en: Pauses via animation-play-state so items can be read

note.zh: 两条反向滚动，制造张力，编辑感首屏常用
note.en: Two strips scrolling opposite ways — editorial hero energy

notes.zh: 把内容复制两份放进 flex 容器，animation: marquee Xs linear infinite，keyframes 到 translateX(-50%)， 两份内容宽度一致才无缝。时长 15～40s 视内容量而定，匀速不缓动。 hover 暂停用 animation-play-state；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 改为静态可横向滚动。
notes.en: Duplicate the content inside a flex container and run animation marquee Xs linear infinite, keyframes to translateX(-50%); both copies must be identical in width for a seamless loop. Duration 15–40s depending on volume, linear, never eased. Pause on hover with animation-play-state; under prefers-reduced-motion fall back to a static horizontally scrollable strip.

basic.zh: 添加一个跑马灯：合作方 logo 横向匀速循环滚动。
basic.en: Add a marquee — partner logos scrolling horizontally in a seamless loop.

design.zh: 合作方条带以 30s 匀速循环滚动，内容复制两份无缝衔接，悬停暂停；灰度 logo、间距一致；不作为信息主通道。
design.en: A partner strip loops at 30s linear with the content duplicated for a seamless seam, pausing on hover; greyscale logos, even spacing; never a primary information channel.

implementation.zh: 纯 CSS：外层 overflow:hidden，内层 flex 内放两份相同内容，animation: marquee 30s linear infinite，@keyframes marquee 到 translateX(-50%)。hover 暂停：animation-play-state: paused。加 prefers-reduced-motion 降级为静态滚动。
implementation.en: CSS-only: outer overflow:hidden, inner flex holding two identical copies, animation marquee 30s linear infinite, keyframes to translateX(-50%). Hover pause via animation-play-state: paused. Degrade to a static scrollable strip under prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目落地页添加合作方 logo 跑马灯。

先检查现有 logo 资源与间距令牌。
要求：
- 内容复制两份实现无缝循环，匀速不缓动
- 悬停暂停；聚焦时也暂停（可访问性）
- 装饰属性：aria-hidden，不进入无障碍阅读流
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a partner-logo marquee to the project's landing page.

Check existing logo assets and spacing tokens first.
Requirements:
- Duplicate content for a seamless loop, linear motion only
- Pause on hover and on focus (accessibility)
- Decorative: aria-hidden, outside the accessibility reading flow
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
